 Advertisment Premium Articles Reliance Group Stock in Focus after Symmetrical Triangle Breakout Signals Big Bullish Move Ahead
 Telecommunication has formed a symmetrical triangle on the 30 min chart, signalling a possible short-term bullish breakout. The company is one of the leading Indian telecommunications players.
 by Shashi Kumar by Shashi Kumar 
 30 Oct 2026 18:15 IST
 Link copied! Copy failed! A bullish symmetrical triangle occurs when a neutral symmetrical triangle pattern forms during an ongoing uptrend and breaks out above its upper resistance line, signalling a powerful continuation of the underlying rally. As prices consolidate within converging trendlines, making lower highs and higher lows, the market temporarily pauses to absorb supply, causing trading volume to contract steadily as the range narrows. The pattern transitions from neutral to explicitly bullish the moment price breaks decisively through the descending resistance trendline on a sharp spike in trading volume, demonstrating that buyers have regained complete control over sellers.  
 Advertisment Jio Platforms Ltd. Chart: 30-min Timeframe 
 The chart shows a confirmed bullish breakout above the resistance neckline. Supported by a volume surge and points to a potential short-term upward move. 
 Jio Platforms Ltd moved above the key resistance level of Rs 1,425 on 30th October, turning it into a strong support zone. The stock closed at Rs 1,438 on the 30-min chart on Friday, indicating sustained bullish momentum and continued buying interest. 
 In a symmetrical triangle pattern, traders typically target the next resistance level or project a price move equal to the triangle’s widest height from the breakout point, while strong buying volume and positive momentum help confirm the bullish breakout. 
 Advertisment Indicator Confirmation 
 RSI: The 30-min RSI indicates buying pressure, as it rose from 57.62 in the previous 30-minute trading session to 62.47. 
 Price Volume Trend: The Price Volume Indicator confirms the uptrend, accompanied by an increase in buying volume in the 30-min time frame. 
 Implications 
 The symmetrical triangle breaking above resistance indicates an upward trend. Sustaining above the Rs 1,425 support level, along with strong trading volumes, could further strengthen the near-term bullish outlook. 
 Advertisment About the Company 
 Jio Platforms Ltd. (JPL), a subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited headquartered in Mumbai, is an Indian multinational technology company. It delivers an end-to-end 5G portfolio comprising radio, core, automation, OSS/BSS, and AI/ML platforms. JPL’s stack supports edge, public, and private cloud deployments for telecom operators and enterprise private networks. Additionally, the company conducts active 6G research at its dedicated in-house facility, Jio Labs. Jio Platforms Ltd has gained 6% since listing on October 28th, 2026.
